capabilities: Detect RTL script per line in Editing view and Live Preview
Apply per-block direction in Reading view
Keep frontmatter, inline code, code blocks, and math LTR
Toggle content direction with a command
Configure Editing and Reading view behavior in plugin settings
disambiguation: Not a full interface RTL switcher; it applies direction only to note content, and the README says to turn off Obsidian's built-in Right-to-left option.
extras: README states the plugin makes no network requests, collects no telemetry, and does not modify note files.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Right-to-left option affects more than note content, so mixed-script notes cannot get per-line direction without flipping the whole interface.
summary: Per-line RTL display for Persian, Arabic, Kurdish, Urdu, and Hebrew script in note content, while interface elements stay left-to-right.
